title_sq: SHITET AKTIVITET BIZNESI KANCELARI + FOTOKOPJE PRANE FAKULTETIT TE INXHINIERISE SE NDERTIMIT NE TIRANE!
description_sq:
Shitet aktiviteti i biznesit i llojit kancelari,fotokopje,printime te ndryshme. Ndodhet ne rrugen kryesore Muhamet Gjollesha perballe me Universitetin Politeknik te Tiranes (UPT) dhe Fakultetin e Inxhinierise se Ndertimit. 
Ky biznes operon ne katin 0 ne rruge kryesore e mjaft te frekuentuar ne nje siperfaqje njesie biznesi prej 33 m2. 
Biznesi eshte aktualisht aktiv dhe ka nje xhiro te mire ditore rreth 15,000 leke te reja ne dite.
Aktualisht kancelaria ka nje kontrate aktive qiraje per minimalisht 4 vite.
Ambjenti i kancelarise eshte open space + nje magazine e vogel per mbajtjen e te gjitha materialeve te punes ose te disponueshme per shitje. Aktiviteti i biznesit disponon te gjitha pajisjet e nevojshme per fotokopje,printime,lidhje diplomash,printime ne format te madh deri ne 25 m.
Eshte nje mundesi e mire investimi per kedo qe do te punoje ne nje biznes te tille.
Per me teper informacione jeni te mirepritur te na kontaktoni.
title_en: BUSINESS ACTIVITY OFFICE FOR SALE + PHOTOCOPY NEAR THE FACULTY OF CONSTRUCTION ENGINEERING IN TIRANA!
description_en: For sale business activity of the stationery type, photocopying, various printing. It is located on the main Muhamet Gjollesha street, in front of the Polytechnic University of Tirana (UPT) and the Faculty of Construction Engineering. This business operates on the 0th floor in the main and very frequented street in a business unit area of ​​33 m2. The business is currently active and has a good daily turnover of about 15,000 new lek per day. Currently, the office has an active lease contract for at least 4 years. The office environment is open space + a small warehouse for keeping all work materials or available for sale. The business activity has all the necessary equipment for photocopying, printing, linking diplomas, printing in large format up to 25 m. It is a good investment opportunity for anyone who will work in such a business. For more information, you are welcome to contact us.
